fixes.where: index.html head (after the two font preloads)
fixes.what: Add <link rel="preload" as="image" href="assets/video/hero-poster-small.jpg" fetchpriority="high"> and put it before the font preloads
fixes.why: The poster is the LCP element on every index load (video arrives only after window load) yet it queues behind two fonts and the CSS.

fixes.what: On each required input listen for 'invalid' and 'input': set aria-invalid="true"/remove it, and write a persistent .field__error line (e.g. 'Enter your email') linked by aria-describedby; keep reportValidity() as the fallback
fixes.why: Native bubbles vanish after a second and are not announced reliably; the brief asks for judged validation and error states.

fixes.what: Reduce stacked section padding on phones: .section{padding-block:clamp(56px,8vh,80px)} and drop the journey's bottom gradient zone to 48px, so journey→Inquire is ~110px, not ~230px
fixes.why: Phone shot 3 shows a third of a screen of empty cream between the last stop and the Inquire eyebrow.

fixes.what: Serve hero-1080-loop.mp4 only when (min-width:1280px) AND devicePixelRatio>=1.5 (or min-width:1600px); everything else gets the 720 loop
fixes.why: A 1024px laptop at 1x pulls the 2.5 MB file where the 1.2 MB 720 loop is visually identical in a 560px arch.

fixes.what: Set min on the date input to today (one line in site.js: input.min = new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)) and add max="2000" to guest count
fixes.why: Past wedding dates and absurd counts pass validation today; two attributes close it.

fixes.what: Move the help line under the input (order:3 in the .field grid) so paired labels sit on one baseline, instead of bottom-aligning only the inputs
fixes.why: Desktop shot 3: 'Your names' label floats 28px above 'Email' label; the row reads misaligned even though the inputs line up.
